## What is Bioconductor?

[Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.org){target="_blank"} is an open-source,
open-development project that provides thousands of R packages for the analysis
and comprehension of biological data, such as genomics, transcriptomics,
single-cell, proteomics, metabolomics, and microbiome data. Behind the software
is a welcoming, international community of users and developers who share code,
teach courses, and meet at conferences.

[Visit Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.org){.btn .btn-dark .rounded-pill
target="_blank"}

## The Finnish Bioconductor community

The Finnish Society for Bioinformatics brings together people in Finland who use
or develop Bioconductor. **Everyone is welcome** — whether you have just
installed your first package or maintain several of them.

Come and meet the community at the [BioBeers](../events.qmd) and our other
events. We are also planning Bioconductor-related events, such as hackathons.

Would you like to help organise them? Join the organising committee by
contacting the society at [fsfbioinf@gmail.com](mailto:fsfbioinf@gmail.com) or
on [Slack](https://bioinffi.slack.com/){target="_blank"}.

## Who is who

Find Bioconductor people near you and get in touch. Click a pin or a name to see
who they are. The list shows the people in the visible part of the map.

Anyone in Finland who uses or develops Bioconductor tools is welcome on the map.
You do not need to be a member of the Finnish Society for Bioinformatics. If you
move abroad, you can stay on the map in your new location. Zoom out to see the
Finnish Bioconductor people around the world.
